basic_details.job_title: BBAU Retired Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU), Lucknow, a Central University, is engaging 1 Retired Professor on a purely temporary, contractual basis for its Department of Pharmaceutical Science at the Satellite Campus, Amethi. Retired Professors from Universities may send the filled application form in PDF format, with all relevant documents, to [email protected] by 08/11/2026 (23:59 hours). The engagement is for one academic session at a fixed remuneration of Rs. 70,000 per month.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Department of Pharmaceutical Science, Satellite Campus Amethi, BBAU, Lucknow

qualification.details: Who can apply: Retired Professors from the Universities. Qualification: The minimum qualifications shall be as per UGC (Minimum Qualifications for Appointment of Teachers and other Academic Staff in Universities and Colleges and other Measures for the Maintenance of Standards in Higher Education) Regulations, 2018. Preference: Mere fulfilment of minimum qualifications does not confer any right to engagement. Higher qualification and/or academic/research achievements may be preferred. Age limit: Retired Professors should not have attained the age of 70 years on the closing date of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Cut-off for qualification and experience: Counted as on the last date of the application form. Pay: Fixed remuneration of Rs. 70,000/- shall be paid per month inclusive of all. Nature of engagement: Purely temporary, for one academic session; candidates will not have any claim whatsoever for appointment or absorption on any regular position. Duty timings: May be staggered and as decided by the University. | For the full minimum qualifications for a Professor in the concerned discipline, candidates should refer to the official notification and the UGC Regulations, 2018 it names.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes by email only. The notice calls it an online application through e-mail; there is no postal route. The application form asks for these details: name of the department; personal details (name, date of birth, father's and mother's name, nationality, gender, religion, community/category, marital status, disability particulars, postal address with PIN code, email and mobile number); educational qualifications from High School to Ph.D. and others; whether the Ph.D. has been awarded with dates of registration, submission and notification; NET UGC/CSIR or an equivalent exam (SLET/SET); a chronological list of experience; total teaching (UG and PG level), post-doctoral, research and other experience; publications in the last five years; academic distinctions; present position with pay; three references; and a signed declaration. The email address you give in the form matters. Letters or notices for the interaction will be sent only to it, BBAU will not be responsible for an invalid or wrong email id, and no communication will be sent by post. Incomplete applications will be out-rightly rejected.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in PDF format, with a passport size photograph pasted on it All relevant documents, sent with the application form Copies of reprints of publications (the form asks for the details to be enclosed, for teaching posts) Additional pages for educational qualifications, if required

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interaction. The notice does not describe any written test. Interaction venue: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Vidya Vihar, Raebareli Road, Lucknow-226025. Call letter: The letter or notice for interaction will be sent by email to shortlisted candidates. The interaction date is not specified in the notice. What to bring: All original documents, to be shown at the time of interaction, and one set of self-attested photocopies of all the documents. Duration: The interaction may continue for the next day depending upon the circumstances, so candidates may come prepared accordingly. Travel: No TA/DA or accommodation shall be provided for attending the interaction.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BBAU Recruitment 2026 for Retired Professor?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Retired Professor in the Department of Pharmaceutical Science, Satellite Campus Amethi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BBAU Retired Professor post?
faq.answer: The filled application must be emailed to [email protected] latest by 08/11/2026 (23:59 hours).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the BBAU Retired Professor post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications are as per the UGC (Minimum Qualifications for Appointment of Teachers and other Academic Staff in Universities and Colleges and other Measures for the Maintenance of Standards in Higher Education) Regulations, 2018. Higher qualification and/or academic/research achievements may be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the BBAU Retired Professor post?
faq.answer: Retired Professors from Universities should not have attained the age of 70 years on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the BBAU Retired Professor?
faq.answer: A fixed remuneration of Rs. 70,000/- per month, inclusive of all, will be paid.

faq.question: Q6. Can retired professors apply, and how is their pay fixed?
faq.answer: Yes, the post is meant for Retired Professors from the Universities. Their pay is a fixed remuneration of Rs. 70,000/- per month, inclusive of all.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for BBAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application form available on www.bbau.ac.in and email it in PDF format, with all relevant documents, to [email protected] by 08/11/2026 (23:59 hours).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the BBAU Retired Professor post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called by email for an interaction at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Vidya Vihar, Raebareli Road, Lucknow-226025, where they must show all original documents.

faq.question: Q9. Is the BBAU Retired Professor post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on a temporary basis for one academic session, and candidates will have no claim for appointment or absorption on any regular position.

faq.question: Q10. Will BBAU pay TA/DA for attending the interaction?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA or accommodation shall be provided, and the interaction may continue for the next day depending upon the circumstances.
